def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # find the topmost row with nonzero cells: the bar
    bar=[i for i in range(H) if any(x!=0 for x in I[i])]
    r0=bar[0]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if I[r0][j]!=0]
    O[r0]=[I[r0][j] if j in cols else 0 for j in range(W)]
    # colors and their columns
    cpos={}
    for j in range(W):
        if I[r0][j]!=0: cpos[I[r0][j]]=j
    # singletons elsewhere
    singles=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]!=0 and i!=r0: singles.append((i,j,I[i][j]))
    for i,j,c in singles:
        col=cpos[c]
        O[i]=[c]*W  # whole row filled with c
        for k in range(min(j,col), max(j,col)+1): O[k][i]=c
        # fill from bar down? demo: 6 at (4,0), 3 at (2,14) -> bars drawn too
        # also draw bar-colored vertical stripes: for each color in bar at col, 
        # fill column from r0 down to singleton row? demo col6 '5': fills all rows below r0
        O[i][col]=c
        # fill column col with c from r0 to singleton row i
        for k in range(r0,i+1): O[k][col]=c
    return O
